To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) there is a substantial reduction in diarrhoea prevalence between the rainy and the dry seasons in Matyazo cell, Huye town; (ii) the distribution of diarrhoea is unequally distributed according to household location; and (iii) poor sanitation conditions within and around homes are the main risk factor of diarrhoea during the rainy and the dryer seasons.
diarrhoea was prevalent during the rainy season but reduced during the dry season, and that households established at higher altitude were protected from diarrhoea in both seasons.
